name: loomdesk-agents
description: LoomDesk plugins for agent frameworks: Coinbase AgentKit, ElizaOS and GOAT.

scripts.install:all: for p in agentkit goat eliza; do (cd packages/$p && npm install) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: for p in agentkit goat eliza; do (cd packages/$p && npm run typecheck) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: for p in agentkit goat eliza; do (cd packages/$p && npm run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node scripts/sync-core.mjs --check && for p in agentkit goat eliza; do (cd packages/$p && npm test) || exit 1; done
scripts.dry-run: for p in agentkit goat eliza; do (cd packages/$p && npm run dry-run) || exit 1; done
